scope: One additional rank-1 RAM-output boundary before recurrent products.
description: Capture current/previous K and V, Q, compressed FP16 state and their coordinate address/valid together after the synchronous RAM read. Multiply from these registers one cycle later. Shift every later state-write/readout consumer and the existing KV/sum tag monitors by one cycle. Keep the 16-bit stored state compressed through the new read stage. Add independent checks of all six data fields plus address/valid and reset while this stage is active. Rank-1 latency adds one cycle/token; arithmetic, output association and coordinate issue order remain unchanged.
